notes.title: Give old sports facilities a second life! Sports: Renovations announced
notes.content:
What happens when a sports game meets a house renovator? A game where you renovate old sports facilities! 

Restore the glory of sports in a [b]relaxing renovator sim[/b], made by Goat Gamez, a studio founded by Movie Games and [b]Robert Lewandowski[/b]!

Wishlist the game now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

How do you save your beloved team’s court from being torn down by a real estate developer? You do what you do best – renovate dilapidated sports facilities to collect the money you need to help out.

Restore gyms, courts, pools and pitches to their former glory, upgrade your tools and expand your headquarters. Collect trophies and mementoes during your renovation missions and display them proudly in a special room for everyone to see.

[b]FEATURES:[/b]

[list][*]Two game modes: Campaign with a predefined number of levels and storyline.
[*]Buy new tools and upgrade the equipment you already own.
[*]Earn money on your renovation jobs and use it to expand your own base of operations – each room unlocked will add some perks and some of the rooms come with a side mission.
[*]Buy cosmetic items you can place around your office.
[*]Trophy room where the player sees various memorabilia collected during renovation missions.[/list]

Are you ready to give sports facilities a second chance?

notes.title: Bundle Updated with Designer DLC!
notes.content:
Hi Mythbusters!

[b]Our bundle, Paleontologist & MythBuster, with Dinosaur Fossil Hunter just got expanded with Designer DLC![/b]

[previewyoutube=Jujck4k-jy8;full][/previewyoutube]

With [b]Designer DLC[/b], you can paint [b]life-sized dinosaur models of all species available in the game[/b]. Grim black T-Rex? Earthly brown triceratops? Or maybe you want to go all out and create the most attention-catching dinosaur possible? Nothing is impossible!

[b]Designer DLC contains[/b]:
- 10 Dinosaur species to paint
- 10 poses for each Dinosaur species to arrange your display
- 2 gameplay modes:
   + Normal (which takes game progression into account)
   + Sandbox (which allows you to paint every Dino from start)[/list]
- 50+ textures for skin, scales etc...
- 30+ skin patterns and decals
- 20+ blood decals
- Full color palette
- 130+ texture sets with skins
- 20+ independent textures for free combination with skin textures
- 30+ additional decals for museum decoration in 2 color variants

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065550/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter__Designer_DLC/

[b]That's not all![/b]

Next month another DLC - [b]Raptor [/b]will also be added to this bundle!

[b]The Raptor DLC will include:[/b]
- new Dinosaur species: Utahraptor ostrommaysi
- new active dig sites on the Dinosaur Canyon location
- 10 skeleton poses
- 252 unique bones

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2217690/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter__Raptor_DLC/

notes.title: Sign up for a playtest! Give us your feedback
notes.content:
Hello, Mythbusters!

Ready for some groundbreaking experiments? [b]Join the playtest for MythBusters: The Game![/b] You can sign up today. We will start the tests later in March.

We’re currently hard at work polishing the game and improving the physics engine, we’ve added a checklist which will show you what to buy for the experiment, and so on. We would love you to play it and get feedback from you!

Sign up for the tests by clicking the "Request Access" button on the main steam page ⬇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/811550/MythBusters_The_Game__Crazy_Experiments_Simulator/ 

If you have questions, shoot them in the comments below this post or join our [url=discord.gg/MovieGames]Discord server[/url], the Mythbusters channel.

Languages available in the playtest:

[list][*]English 
[*]French 
[*]German 
[*]Polish 
[*]Spanish 
[*]Simplified Chinese[/list]

Sign up now!

notes.title: Status Update – What are we working on?
notes.content:
Hello, Mythbusters!

We’re sure you are curious about what we’re doing now, so we bring you some more news from the first lines. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024330/aa6eb2d4619a8504298a30db84f3def4e6e096af.jpg[/img]

We’re now working on improving the overall clarity of the game. We’re adjusting the UI so it is easier to understand. We want you to navigate it with more ease and we want it to look neat. We’re also adding the checklist mechanic, so while playing you’ll be able to track your progress step by step and see what’s been done and what more remains until the myth is completed. 

What’s more, we’re correcting markers and texts, and we’re fixing some bugs we’ve caught. Overall, the work is ongoing and we are polishing the game with fervour! 

Stay tuned for more news. Wishlist the game if you haven’t already, it really helps us out! See ya!

notes.title: Next goal ACHIEVED, 222% funded, 4 days left!
notes.content:
[b]It’s CONFIRMED: we CAN achieve 5 goals within our campaign![/b]

Hi Mythbusters, we’ve just hit our 5th goal. This means our game will now feature [b]more customization options[/b] to let you make your experiments truly yours. As always, thanks! 

Now, let’s prepare for the home stretch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024330/739ebc3bd373094bb4f9c70f3078d1e056bda4a8.gif[/img]

[b]We have 4 days left and still more goals to meet![/b]

From new collectibles to additional firearms to test, to new camera modes or even a complete new myth to explore.

[h3][url=mov.gs/mbks]Help Us Out on Kickstarter[/url][/h3]

We can do it, but only with you!

[b]Here are the many ways you can help us if you have already backed us:[/b]

[list]
[*] Spread the news about our campaign on social media. This also counts towards our social goals, which add smaller content to our game.
[*] Add our game to your [url=https://mov.gs/mbsteam]Steam Wishlist[/url]. You’ll make us more visible on Steam.
[*] Follow our publisher’s [url=https://twitter.com/MovieGamesSA]Twitter [/url]for future updates.
[*] If you’re already backed us, you also can increase your pledge.
[/list]

Let’s make these final days truly epic!

Yours,
Ernest

notes.title: More Blueprints FUNDED on Kickstarter
notes.content:
We’ve made it! Or rather: you’ve made us make it!

We’ve reached the next stretch goal of our Kickstarter campaign. More blueprints are FUNDED! This means we can create additional “big” experiments to solve within our myths! Thank you again for your support - and let’s make it to another goal!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/79AVnd9BG8ORfFrNF4/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611fe84e51e4f792082bd91611560aa6fa88a9bf0e4&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

[h3]Next up: MORE CUSTOMIZATION OF CRAFTER ITEMS[/h3]

If we reach it, you will be able to choose different decals, paint jobs, or other details for the items you use in our experiments.

Customization already exists in our game, but you can help us expand it. This way your experiments can become more unique!

[h3]Let’s see if we can reach this goal![/h3]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mythbusters/mythbusters-the-game-crazy-experiments-simulator]SEE OUR KICKSTARTER CAMPAIGN
[/url]

Also, consider adding our game to your Steam Wishlist to give us a visibility boost on the platform.

See you next time, Mythbusters!
